name: Cloud
overview: The Bible reveals the cloud as a powerful symbol of God's presence and guidance among His people. In Exodus, the Lord leads Israel by day in a pillar of cloud and by night in a pillar of fire, never removing His protective presence (Exodus 13:21-22). The cloud also serves as a visible manifestation of God's glory, as seen when the glory of the Lord appears in the cloud before the people (Exodus 16:10) and when God speaks to Moses from a thick cloud to confirm His word and authority (Exodus 19:9). Additionally, the cloud functions as a protective and directing presence during Israel's journey, standing behind them to guard against enemies (Exodus 14:19, 24).
